newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks end down 2.79pct, finance concerns.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks end down 2.79pct, finance concerns.

text.p: (Corrects figure in headline and text from 3.02 percent)
Thai stocks finished a hefty 2.79 percent (corrects) down in thin turnover on Monday as investors sold stocks across the board on further concerns about liquidity of finance firms, brokers said.

"Investors tend to believe that there would be more than 10 finance companies announced by the central bank earlier today that have liquidity problems," said Somnuk Chanrasamee of Nava Finance and Securities.
The SET index finished 21.95 points lower at 705.61 on thin 1.3 billion baht turnover. The SET-50 index fell 1.81 points to 51.84. Trading was suspended in banks and finance issues.
